preconditions.description: The number of songs (n+1) and queries (q) are within the bounds 1 to 10^5.
The initial song s_0 has length between 1 and 100, and the string t has length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s_0 + t)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_0 and t are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query's song index k is between 0 and n (inclusive).
Each query's sailor name w is a non-empty string.
The total length of all sailor names across queries does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == count_occurrences(s_k, w) % (10**9 + 7) for i, (k, w) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (k, w), the output line is the count of occurrences of w as a substring in s_k modulo 10^9+7.
